items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Talking to Russ and Fuzzy and Itzy, they were in the band

ctx.x: Now then --oh, yes, I did hear them. They were with the Sirens at a house party at Penn.State. Maybe a year before or after, but didn't get a chance then to talk to them. Jimmy and Alfie were saxophone players.

Now, let me see, well, I went up one Sunday. We had Sunday off and they were working on Sunday in Detroit, it didn't make any difference. I think Monday was the night they had off, so I went down there and little old home week. Talking to Russ and Fuzzy and Itzy, they were in the band, and I met Jimmy then. So Russ took me down in the cellar, in the Greystone Ballroom, Charlie Horvath, the manager, his office was down in the cellar, way back in the back, so we went down there and he said, "I want you to meet this…
to -- we went down and talked to Charlie and Russ said, "Why don't you have this guy make some arrangements for you? He can write$."
